title: Rewrite matches with groups
description: This program uses replacement references and functions to reorder or change selected parts of regex matches.

steps.description: NAME captures last and first names. The two substitutions rebuild each match with the captured names in first-name-first order.
The password pattern captures password= and matches the value after it. Its replacement keeps the captured prefix and writes literal asterisks.

steps.question: What happens to each password value in config?
steps.answer: Each value after password= is replaced with four asterisks while password= remains.

steps.description: The \g<1> form makes group 1 followed by digits unambiguous. The final substitution omits the raw-string prefix, so Python changes the backslash escapes before re sees them.
to_12h computes replacement text from captured hour and minute groups. The lambda replacement uppercases only the captured variable name.
re.sub calls to_12h for each time match and inserts the string it returns.
